mapper.select: SELECT MEMBER_ID AS memberId, PASSWORD AS password, MEMBER_NAME AS memberName, ROLE AS role, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT AS loginFailCount, IS_LOCKED AS isLocked, LAST_LOGIN_AT AS lastLoginAt FROM MEMBER WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId}
mapper.update: UPDATE MEMBER SET IS_LOCKED = CASE WHEN LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1 >= 5 THEN 1 ELSE IS_LOCKED END, LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT + 1 WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_LOCKED = 0
UPDATE MEMBER SET LOGIN_FAIL_COUNT = 0, LAST_LOGIN_AT = NOW() WHERE MEMBER_ID = #{memberId} AND IS_LOCKED = 0
